20091.long_desc:
The Mermaid Fantasy Arcade Game is an English version video redemption game in which players must catch fish and hunt down the stunning mermaid characters!

The 3D rendered ocean scenery is the perfect backdrop for this dreamy Mermaid Fantasy arcade game which includes 5 special mermaid characters to catch, plus the game is loaded with exciting mini games and fun characters.
Characters in the Mermaid Fantasy Arcade Game include:

Lion fish, Jellyfish, Lantern Fish, Devilfish, Flying Fish, Sea Turtle, Laser Shark, Bomb Crab, Laser Crab, Drill Crab, Golden Shark and the always impressive Fire Dragon.

Some fish in the Mermaid Fantasy Arcade Game come with features that reward the players who catch them, creating a greater element of challenge for players to enjoy.
Mermaid Fantasy Arcade Game features include:

-King Fish â€“ The King Fish is coloured dark red to stand out, and when players catch this fish it will automatically catch all the fish of the same species currently on the screen, and award the points to the player.

-Bomb Crab â€“ The Bomb Crab will explode when caught, awarding all the points from fish caught in the explosion to the player.

-Drill Crab â€“ The Drill Crab will award the player who catches it with a drill weapon. Players simply point and shoot the weapon, which will damge and/or catch fish as it ricochets around the screen.

-Laser Crab â€“ The Laser Crab awards the player who catches it with a single laser beam shot weapon, which will take out most fish that are hit by the beam and will award all points to the player.

-Lightning Chain â€“ A fish feature that when caught will start a lightning chain, where various kinds of fish can be caught in the chain. All points from fish caught in the chain will be awarded to the player.

-Golden Treasure Shark â€“ The Golden Treasure Shark is a bigger version of the Golden Shark, but it is shackled with a treasure chest. Players must catch 5 of these Golden Treasure Sharks to earn the big bonus.
